selection: Ten cohesive responsibility/coupling risks selected from untouched source, size/churn/constructor/complexity/coverage diagnostics. Ranking order represents implementation priority, not a size-only formula. A hotspot is not resolved by line count alone.

hotspots.reason: Startup, configuration, mode dispatch, runtime/project replacement, interactive command orchestration and resource/auth/model coordination share top-level state.
Terminal protocol control, transcript/stream state, rendering, layout, selectors and lifecycle all mutate the screen.
Input decoding, editor state, history/completion, selection, keybinding actions and dialog/run orchestration are concentrated.
One long streamed attempt mixes retry, tool/lifecycle projection, steering queues, compaction, persistence and settlement; 17 constructor parameters.
Canonical conversation/tree mutation, persistence, usage projection, branch restoration, tools/store and compatibility state are concentrated.
Pi JSONL parsing/version compatibility, message/content conversion, state import/export and recovery semantics share a large serializer.
MAF composition, tool catalog/loadout lifecycle, history, virtual routing, system/context projection and summarization; largest collaborator constructor.
Provider credentials, discovery/snapshot/scopes, llama catalog/cache and virtual model selection share mutable orchestration.
Read/image handling, write/edit, bash/process lifetime, environment and execution observation share one tool facade.
SDK connection lifetime, lazy reach/namespace waiting, tool registration/schema projection, resources and server instructions are mixed.
